Grout Tile Backsplash
description: Provide labor and material to prep and protect adjacent finishes, clean existing backsplash tile surfaces, and grout existing subway tile backsplash at kitchen walls. Scope includes tooling and cleanup of grout joints, caulking at change-of-plane transitions as needed, and final cleanup of work area. Existing tile is assumed to be secure and properly bonded. Replacement of loose, cracked, or damaged tile is excluded unless otherwise noted. Grout color TBD.

name: Ceiling T&G install
description: Provide labor only to install owner-supplied prefinished tongue-and-groove ceiling material at exposed ceiling framing areas as shown. Scope includes layout, cutting, fitting, fastening, and finish installation of provided material. Owner to supply all finish ceiling material prior to installation. Estimate assumes framing and substrate conditions are adequate for installation and that material provided is usable and acclimated to site conditions. Touch-up, refinishing, material replacement, or correction of defective owner-supplied material is excluded unless otherwise noted.

name: 2x12 Mitigation repair
description: Provide labor and material to secure and reinforce previously cut 2x12 framing member and perform finish carpentry repairs necessary to visually integrate repaired area with existing exposed beam construction. Scope includes installation of decorative trim details at beam-to-drywall intersections to conceal repair areas and provide a cohesive finished appearance consistent with existing wood finishes. Repair approach based on existing engineering requirements and approved repair method.

name: Finish bedroom closets
description: Provide labor and material to complete framing and finish carpentry work at both bedroom closet openings to accommodate new bi-fold closet doors at approximately 48" openings. Scope includes framing modifications as required, drywall repair associated with framing work, and installation of trim details designed to complement the existing craftsman-style aesthetic of the residence. Final closet door style and finish to be selected by owner prior to installation.

name: Siding repair
description: Evaluate and install missing siding on the front left and rear left corners of the home.

name: Window Replacement Allowance
description: Provide labor and material to remove existing windows and modify existing openings as required to accommodate new nail-flange vinyl windows throughout residence. Scope includes installation of seven (7) 36"x54" single-hung windows at living room and bedroom locations, one (1) 32"x40" kitchen window, and one (1) 36"x36" obscure tempered-glass bathroom window. Installation to include flashing tape, sealants, fasteners, insulating foam, weatherproofing, and integration with existing wall assemblies as required for proper installation.

Door Replacement Allowance
description: Provide labor and material to remove existing exterior doors and modify existing openings as required to accommodate new exterior door assemblies. Front entry opening to be modified to accept new 36" exterior door and rear kitchen entry opening to be modified to accept new 32" exterior door. Scope includes framing modifications, installation of new prehung door units, flashing, sealants, fasteners, weatherstripping, insulation, and adjustment for proper operation and fit. Door style to be craftsman style with final door selection and finish to be determined by owner prior to ordering. Finish trim, paint, hardware upgrades, and locksets to be provided under separate finish carpentry and paint scopes.

name: Door Hardware
description: Provide labor and material to supply and install three (3) interior locksets and two (2) exterior keyed locksets. Scope includes installation, adjustment, and alignment of hardware for proper fit and operation at new door assemblies. Final hardware style and finish to be selected by owner prior to ordering.

name: Interior Trim Allowance
description: Provide labor and material to furnish and install interior finish trim throughout residence including window casing, door casing, and base trim at living room, kitchen, hallway, bathroom, and bedroom areas. Scope includes trim installation at approximately eight (8) window openings and eight (8) door openings, along with installation of new baseboard trim throughout primary living areas and bedrooms. Work includes cutting, fitting, fastening, caulking, filling nail holes, and preparation for paint. Trim profile to be flatstock MDF 1x4 sides, 5/4 x 6 head stock and 1/2 x 4 1/4 base.

name: Exterior Window and Door Allowance
description: Provide labor and material to furnish and install exterior window and door trim at all new exterior openings including nine (9) window assemblies and front and rear exterior doors. Scope includes installation of 5/4 exterior wood trim in craftsman-style profile as discussed, along with all required flashing integration and weather sealing in accordance with applicable building code requirements and manufacturer installation standards. Work includes cutting, fitting, fastening, caulking, surface preparation, and prep for paint at all new exterior trim assemblies. Final trim details and proportions to be coordinated with overall exterior finish aesthetic.

name: Demo
description: Provide labor and material to perform selective demolition of existing bathroom finishes and fixtures down to exposed wall framing and floor joist system in preparation for remodel work and inspection of existing subfloor conditions. Scope includes removal and disposal of existing flooring, subfloor, fixtures, vanity, toilet, wall finishes, and associated materials as required to expose framing and evaluate potential moisture or rot damage. Existing ceiling to remain in place unless otherwise noted. Minor framing repair associated with standard subfloor replacement is included; extensive structural repair, beam replacement, or engineered structural modifications resulting from concealed damage are excluded unless otherwise noted.

name: Framing and Subfloor Repair
description: Provide labor and material to perform framing modifications and rough carpentry associated with bathroom remodel scope including installation of backing and blocking required for waterproofing assemblies, fixture support, and finish installation. Scope includes framing modifications required for new bathroom window installation and replacement of damaged or deteriorated subfloor materials as required within exposed bathroom floor areas. Work to be performed using conventional framing methods consistent with existing construction. Extensive structural repair or correction of concealed conditions beyond accessible bathroom framing areas is excluded unless otherwise noted.

name: Plumbing
description: Provide labor and material to perform plumbing rough-in modifications associated with bathroom remodel scope including installation of new tub drain assembly, bathtub unit, and new tub/shower valve system with associated plumbing connections. Scope includes verification and adjustment of existing drain, waste, vent, and water supply lines as required for proper installation and function of new bathtub, toilet, and vanity fixtures. Work includes connection of vanity water supply and drain lines and confirmation of existing plumbing venting configuration within accessible bathroom areas. Repairs or modifications to concealed plumbing systems beyond accessible work areas are excluded unless otherwise noted.

name: Insulation
description: Provide labor and material to install insulation at exterior bathroom wall assemblies and exposed floor framing areas associated with remodel scope, approximately 80 square feet total. Scope includes fitting and installation of insulation materials within accessible framing cavities to improve thermal performance and prepare areas for finish installation.

name: Drywall
description: Provide labor and material to install, tape, and finish drywall at bathroom wall areas associated with remodel scope. Scope includes patching and finishing of drywall surfaces as required following plumbing, framing, insulation, and electrical work. Drywall finish to be smooth wall finish consistent with existing adjacent interior finishes. Ceiling repairs excluded unless otherwise noted.

name: Tile Package
description: Provide labor and material to furnish and install complete bathroom tile package including approximately 105 square feet of tile installation consisting of tub/shower surround wall tile and bathroom floor tile. Scope includes all required waterproofing systems and substrate preparation for wet area installations, installation of floor and wall tile, thin set mortar, grout, underlayment materials, waterproof membranes, and metal edge/accent trim profiles as required for finished installation. Work includes layout, cutting, fitting, grout installation, sealant at change-of-plane transitions, and final cleanup. Tile material selection and layout pattern to be finalized by owner prior to installation.

name: Vanity
description: Provide labor and material allowance for one (1) 24" single-sink bathroom vanity assembly including vanity cabinet and sink basin. Scope includes standard installation and connection to existing prepared plumbing rough-in locations. Final vanity style, finish, countertop material, faucet, and hardware selections to be determined by owner within allowance parameters prior to ordering.

name: Electrical
description: Provide labor and material to complete electrical finish work associated with bathroom remodel scope including installation of switches, receptacles, cover plates, vanity light fixture, and final device trim-out at existing rough-in locations. Scope includes testing and adjustment of installed devices for proper operation. Modifications to existing rough wiring, panel upgrades, or additional circuit installation are excluded unless otherwise noted.

name: ASBESTOS TESTING
description: Provide coordination and allowance for asbestos testing of materials required to be disturbed during remodel activities in accordance with local disposal and waste handling requirements. Scope includes collection and submission of required samples to certified testing facility prior to demolition activities where applicable. Additional abatement, remediation, or hazardous material handling resulting from positive test results is excluded unless otherwise noted.

name: DISPOSAL & DUMP FEES
description: Provide labor and material for collection, handling, transportation, and disposal of construction and demolition debris generated by project activities. Scope includes dump fees, loading, hauling, and disposal of non-hazardous construction materials associated with approved project scope. Disposal of hazardous materials, asbestos-containing materials, or regulated waste requiring special handling is excluded unless otherwise noted.

name: PORTABLE RESTROOM FACILITIES
description: Provide temporary portable restroom facilities as required for construction activities and compliance with applicable L&I jobsite requirements. Scope includes delivery, rental, servicing, and removal for duration of project work.

name: DUST CONTAINMENT & FLOOR PROTECTION
description: Provide labor and material for installation and maintenance of temporary dust containment barriers and floor protection measures throughout active construction areas. Scope includes protection of existing hardwood flooring and adjacent finished surfaces using protective coverings and dust control methods appropriate for remodel construction activities. Work areas to be isolated as reasonably necessary to minimize dust migration and protect recently refinished flooring and existing interior finishes throughout duration of project work.

name: Provide labor and material to furnish and install one (1) Daikin Entra ductless mini split HVAC system including 12,000 BTU exterior condenser unit and 12,000 BTU wall-mounted interior evaporator unit. Scope includes approximately 30 linear feet of 1/4" x 3/8" copper line set, exterior condenser wall-mount bracket, condensate drain line, and 4" line set cover system with associated fittings and trim components. Installation to include system startup and operational testing. Electrical connections and permit fees to be provided under separate electrical and permit scopes by General Contractor.
Electrical disconnect Allowance
description: Provide labor and material to install dedicated electrical supply for new ductless mini split HVAC system including required disconnects, overcurrent protection, and service receptacle located within 25 feet of exterior condenser unit in accordance with applicable electrical code requirements. Scope includes required electrical permit fees and final electrical connection associated with HVAC installation.
